description: Ground-truth semantic edges used to verify inference in the demo. The stage-4 sync agent must DISCOVER these via vector similarity between fragment embeddings; they are NOT declared as `uses` edges anywhere in the SDK. This file is the answer key: a correct sync run should surface both edges below.

edges.note: triage-router's local `routing-rules` fragment paraphrases the shared escalation-criteria inline (it lists the same food-safety / churn-risk / repeated-contact / legal-and-press triggers in its own words to decide routing), instead of referencing the shared fragment. No declared edge exists, so the agent must find this by embedding similarity.

escalation-writer's local `context` fragment loosely paraphrases the shared refund-policy (it restates the 48-hour claim window, per-crate crediting, and the sales-director sign-off threshold when framing the escalation) without declaring a dependency. The overlap is loose wording, not a copy, so only vector similarity catches it.
